summary: One prompt has a direct answer on the page; the other is only touched in passing.

items.text: Prompt 1: The page answers this directly with a no-code method and steps.
items.detail: Covered in the H1 "(No Developer Required)", the At a Glance box, and the FAQ "Do I need to know how to code?". It never says staff need no app.

items.text: Prompt 2: The page touches plans but does not say which plan includes scheduled texts.
items.detail: Only "Scheduling is available on [paid plans]" in Step 2. No pricing table or FAQ names the plan.
